extDescription.message: Collect fragments from across your tabs and weave them into cited reports, rewrites, diagrams and fact-checks.

settings_provider_hint.message: Pick a provider to prefill its endpoint and a default model. Bring your own key — it never leaves your machine except to this endpoint.

settings_model_hint.message: Model identifier. Editable — model names change often.

settings_baseurl_hint.message: Prefilled from the provider. Only change for self-hosted or proxy endpoints.

settings_search_hint.message: Powers Deep Search and online cross-checking. Queries go only to the provider you pick. Weft never scrapes Google or Bing — that breaks their terms and gets extensions rejected.

wb_input_placeholder.message: Type your message or select a scenario above…

wb_page_unavailable.message: Not available on browser pages — open a normal web page to use this.

cite_no_source.message: No source page saved for this citation.

cite_passage_changed.message: Opened the source — the original passage may have changed.

cite_open_failed.message: Could not open the source page

popup_no_session.message: No session yet — create one in the Workbench.

popup_empty.message:
Nothing collected yet.
Select text on a page and click Save in the toolbar.

popup_hint.message: Select text on any page — a toolbar appears with Save and quick analyses.

wb_show_on_page.message: Highlight this session's snippets on the current page

wb_no_snippets.message: No snippets in this session yet.

wb_session_exists.message: A session with that name already exists.

wb_delete_confirm.message: Delete session “%s” and all its snippets?

wb_highlight_none.message: No snippets from this session found on this page.

wb_need_snippets.message: Collect a few snippets first — then run a scenario.

settings_back_banner.message: Click the Weft icon in your toolbar to return to the extension popup.

settings_subtitle.message: Configure your LLM API connection and preferences

settings_rag_hint.message: When enabled, only the most relevant snippets are sent to the AI based on your query. When disabled, all snippets are sent. Useful when sessions contain many snippets to reduce token usage and improve answer quality.

wb_ask_about_selection.message: Ask a question about the selected passage…

settings_lang_hint.message: Sets the interface language and asks the AI to answer in the same language, whatever language the source page is in. The interface is currently translated into English and 简体中文; other choices keep the English interface but still change the AI's answers.

tb_verify_hint.message: Check how well this holds up

tb_ask_hint.message: Ask your own question about this

card_save_hint.message: Save the passage and this result to your session

card_disconnected.message: The connection to Weft ended before an answer arrived. Try again.

card_reload.message: Weft was reloaded — refresh the page and try again.

toast_save_failed.message: Could not save — try reloading the page.

settings_search_note_self.message: Point Weft at a SearXNG instance whose JSON API is open — in practice that means one you run yourself. Public instances almost always disable it.

settings_search_note_tavily.message: Free tier: about 1,000 searches a month, no credit card. Sign up at tavily.com, then paste the key below.

settings_search_note_brave.message: Paid: Brave ended its free tier in 2026 and now bills per request.

settings_search_json_note.message: The instance must have the JSON output format enabled (search.formats in its settings.yml). Most public instances turn it off, so this usually means running your own.
